interface.prototype: int RangeClamp(int value, int lower, int upper);
interface.preconditions: lower <= upper. All arguments may be any representable int consistent with that ordering.
interface.return_value: Return lower when value < lower, upper when value > upper, otherwise value.

behavior.state: None. No global, static, or caller-owned state.
steps: Clamp to the inclusive lower bound.
Clamp to the inclusive upper bound.

constraints: Do not call external APIs, allocate memory, loop, or recurse.
Do not subtract the bounds or otherwise introduce overflow.
